answer: Each agent must stake tokens and publish a signed beacon every epoch; peers verify liveness and history. Sybils splitting into many identities must fund each stake and sustain beacons, multiplying costs linearly. A plume of duplicate registrations from one cluster gets flagged when its beacon timing and stake trail overlap, and a ridge of corroborating peer attestations is required prior to rewards unlock, so fake identities gain nothing while honest agents build reputation. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
